description: M8 check script, seed 1, one player, with night mobs: the debug tools make the Big House a Citadel (building 8, level 10, four cannon ports), put a Stables 20 m east (building 9) with two horses (ids 10, 11) and an ox (id 12), a siege kit 20 m west (catapult 13, ballista 14, bronze cannon 15, 20 of each munition and the research), a goblin village 80 m north (its huts include id 22) and a troop kit 20 m east and 20 m south of the Big House (a Barracks, a level 4 forge, the materials and research of every tier); the Big House trains a long-melee spearman (troop product 4306, id 218) and the Stables trains a bronze cavalry rider (troop product 4640: cavalry, weapon and armour tier 4, id 350), who uses up horse 10 from its stalls and comes out mounted (Troops and gear: cavalry is a troop type trained at the Stables); the ox is hitched to the catapult and hauls it 40 m north, and horse 11 is hitched to the bronze cannon and hauls it into one of the Citadel's ports on the roof; at dusk the gun kit trains every warrior to crew a cannon, two of the starting warriors (5, 6) go up into the port to crew the cannon and the third (7) and the spearman crew the catapult; the catapult is told to break hut 22 and goes on to break more of the village, which goes to war; the crew fight off the goblins that reach the catapult; through night 0 the port cannon fires at the night mobs, and the rider attack-moves 40 m south-west, where his first blow on a zombie after a straight gallop is a charge (double damage, knocked back); at dawn he rides home to the Stables. Debug threats: 10 goblin village, 50 Stables, 51 siege kit, 52 gun kit, 53 Citadel, 54 troop kit, 60 on the late night mobs, 90 Morvath, 91 on a late wave. Products: 4096 + troop x 100 + weapon tier x 10 + armour tier. Moves are world units (8,000 per metre).
